text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, January 7, 2019 Posted by admin on January 7th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +22 points.
Friday the Dow was up +746.94 (+3.29%) at 23,433.16.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.45%.
All 30 Dow stocks were up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Intel (INTC) +6.14%, Caterpillar (CAT) +5.46%, Boeing (BA) +5.20%, Microsoft (MSFT) +4.65%, American Express (AXP) +4.51%, Cisco (CSCO) +4.50%, Visa (V) +4.31%Apple (AAPL) +4.27%, DowDuPont (DWDP) +4.23% and 3M (MMM) +4.11%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were not to be found.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down three-tenths of a cent at $2.237 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
JPMorgan (JPM) reports earnings on 1/15/2019 before the market open.
UnitedHealth (UNH) reports earnings on 1/15/2019 before the market open.
American Express (AXP) reports earnings on 1/17/2019 after the market close.
